svg.title: Known-best n=29: descriptive contact census
svg.desc: House rendering of known-best n=29 with dashed graph edges for contacts detected at angle tolerance 1e-06 radians and contact tolerance 0.001. Lines join square centres or centres to walls; they are descriptive graph incidence, not exact physical contact loci or rigidity certificates.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete rational centre/half-angle certificate of PR 622 at 3115557, read exactly from a release asset whose size and SHA-256 a manifest of that commit pins, and equal there to the source's own corners Witness/v2; no upstream byte is retained. Finite construction feasibility only; a padding reduction of a packing others found, with no novelty, priority, local minimum, rigidity or global optimality claim.

g.data-semantics: tolerance-qualified graph edges, not exact contact loci
